#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepend a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and current date."""
import datetime
import os
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas


def main():
    input_path = "report.pdf"
    if not os.path.exists(input_path):
        raise SystemExit(f"report.pdf not found in workspace")

    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    title = "Annual Financial Report"

    # Build the cover page with reportlab
    fd, cover_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".pdf", prefix="cover_")
    os.close(fd)

    c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    # Title centered in the upper-middle area
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    tw = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawString((width - tw) / 2, height / 2 + 40, title)

    # Current date centered below the title
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    dw = c.stringWidth(today, "Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawString((width - dw) / 2, height / 2 - 10, today)
    c.save()

    # Merge: cover page first, then all original report pages
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
    for page in cover_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    report_reader = PdfReader(input_path)
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(input_path, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    os.unlink(cover_path)

    # Validate the result
    check_reader = PdfReader(input_path)
    first_text = check_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    assert "Annual Financial Report" in first_text, "cover title missing from page 1"
    assert today in first_text, "cover date missing from page 1"
    print(
        f"OK: cover page added to {input_path} "
        f"(title={title!r}, date={today!r}, total_pages={len(check_reader.pages)})"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    for page in reader.pages:
